ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the query is a short, well-defined definitional request (define "bias" in Theory of Knowledge) with clear completion criteria. The two models are essentially tied on the relevant capability dimensions (Extraction & Retrieval and general knowledge differences are within or near run-to-run variance), so capability isn't a deciding factor. Avocet explicitly self-reports preferring well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks like this one, while Whimbrel reports flat preferences across most dimensions. Given the tie on quality, I routed to the model whose stated task preference best matches the request.
